basic_profile.bio: Originally from a small town in Oregon, I'm a 28-year-old IT technician with a knack for building custom PCs. When I'm not tinkering with hardware, I enjoy attending live indie music gigs and exploring the local food scene. I'm currently single and spend most of my evenings online, usually between 7 PM and midnight PST. I'm passionate about technology and have a soft spot for ducks, which I consider the most epic of all birds.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Information Technology and have been working in the field for the past 5 years. My expertise in PC building comes from both my professional experience and a lifelong hobby of staying updated with the latest in hardware trends. I am self-taught in many aspects, often diving into forums and online courses to expand my knowledge.
